title: Sales By Representative for a past date shows the same totals
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Before the release was installed, you exported Sales By Representative (Expanded CSV) for a past date range with invoices, with Show Unassigned on.
    For example: the range is 1 Aug 2026 to 31 Aug 2026.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed and Reports > Sales By Representative is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • The browser window is a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, and the design pictures "sbr-00-b-sbr.png" (board 4.0), "sbr-01-b-sbr-filter.png" (board 4.1), "sbr-02-b-sbr-columns.png" (board 4.2) and "sbr-03-b-sbr-expanded.png" (board 4.3) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Set the same date range as the export made before the release.
  2. Turn Show Unassigned on.
  3. Turn the Sales Type column on in the column selector.
  4. Compare each representative's summary row and the report totals with the export made before the release.
  5. Read the Sales Type of the past invoice rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report shows that date range.
  • Step 2: Show Unassigned is on.
  • Step 3: the report shows the same representatives, with a Sales Type column.
  • Step 4: every summary row and every total is the same as before, to the cent.
  • Step 5: each past work-order invoice is one "Labor, Parts" row under the person it had before; part sales read "Part Sales".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-E2: “Every invoice created before the release has its one representative on both sides, so the report for any past date reads exactly as before, with that person's Labor and Parts rows shown as one "Labor, Parts" row (S5-R10). Invoices created before 2026-07-29 have no representative recorded; they stay Unassigned on both sides, and none is added.”
  • Release day: “Past invoices do not change. Each existing invoice's one name is copied to both sides, so the report for any past date reads exactly as before.”
  • Story 5 context note: “* Context note: the report already adds up labor and parts separately on every invoice. This story changes who is credited with each part, not how the money is counted.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
